This is the initial Community directory release of **Dynamic Template Children Updater**.

## Highlights

- Synchronizes existing child notes with evolving core Templates and Templater templates.
- Applies the same previous-default-or-enabled-toggle rule to property keys, property values, headings, and body text.
- Preserves child-specific customizations when their corresponding enforcement toggle is disabled.
- Projects `${digitalPageCount}` as a typed dynamic scalar without an erroneous diagnostic or loss of a child's numeric page count.
- Preserves compatibility with dynamic baselines created by version 0.3.0.
- Includes an installable, CI-verified `main.js` matching the committed TypeScript source.

## Renamed plugin ID

The former `dynamically-updating-templates` ID is now `dynamic-template-children-updater`. Install this release in `.obsidian/plugins/dynamic-template-children-updater`. Disable the former plugin first; if desired, copy its `data.json` into the new folder before enabling this version.
